translation.text: He will make peace for the righteous and guard the chosen. Mercy will be upon them, and they will all belong to God. They will prosper and be blessed, and God’s light will shine for them.[a]

footnotes.text: The selected opening bracketed phrase, literally “for all the righteous, all of them,” duplicates the surrounding righteous expressions; Charles printed4note9 calls it a dittography. The complete bracketed words remain in the source, while English expresses their repeated meaning once. This is an explicit critical treatment, not a claim of missing ancient text.
